verdict.rationale: Remote-desktop streaming quality is a fair axis for TeamViewer, but the evidence pack has no documentation of hardware encoding, codecs, frame rates or latency for interactive use. Community remarks such as "works very well" are generic and do not address encoding or latency, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a power user, the stream is hardware-encoded and low-latency enough for interactive work, not just passive viewing
